grade.answer_reason: It says the upload will fail and cites the 5,000-part limit from the gateway 2.3 docs (read 2026-05-30). It works out about 7,153 parts at 8 MiB and gives a valid minimum (about 11.5 MiB for decimal GB). It recommends a fixed CHUNK_MB=64 or a part size computed from the file size, both within the 8–512 MiB range, and says to check the limits against the deployed version.
